SELECT c.contract_id as contractId, c.contract_start_date as contractStartDate, c.contract_end_date as contractEndDate, c.total_budget as totalBudget, c.payment_method as paymentMethod, c.contract_status as contractStatus, c.origin_contract_url as originContractUrl, c.platform_contract_url as platformContractUrl, c.ai_report_url as aiReportUrl, c.contracted_at as contractedAt, c.completed_at as completedAt, c.cancel_reason as cancelReason, c.client_rating as clientRating, c.client_experience as clientExperience, c.client_is_renewal_intended as clientIsRenewalIntended, c.freelancer_rating as freelancerRating, c.freelancer_experience as freelancerExperience FROM contracts c INNER JOIN projects p ON CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(c.origin_contract_url, '/', 3), '/', -1) AS UNSIGNED) = p.project_id WHERE p.client_id = #{clientId} AND p.project_id = #{projectId} AND c.contract_status != 'TERMINATED' AND c.origin_contract_url LIKE CONCAT('contracts/', #{clientId}, '/', #{projectId}, '/', #{freelancerId}, '/%') AND CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(c.origin_contract_url, '/', 4), '/', -1) AS UNSIGNED) = #{freelancerId} ORDER BY c.contract_id DESC LIMIT 1
